clean.tl: Some will not pay me, some will give me soap, others give me a gift.

clean.tx: yaŋ a chɔŋ nhɔk ma mi ɛ len nbolom dɛ
clean.tl: Me, I love it in my own language, Bolom.

clean.tx: a chɔŋ npanth machɛk len kɛ ma katho
clean.tl: I like farmwork, but it is hard!

clean.tx: kil thilɛ tha Pujoŋ kunɛ tha bom
clean.tl: The houses in Pujehun are big.

clean.tx: ŋa lai le kunε tee
clean.tl: They continued in this way a long time, they remained this way for a while.

clean.tx: mɔ kɔi minɛ koŋ pulipuli gbi jo ɛ mɔi gbiŋkith
clean.tl: You then mix it all, the food, then you cover it.

clean.tx: wɔ hai chi
clean.tl: Then he goes to sea, catches the fish, and brings them back.

clean.tx: takba hin ɛ wɔ i si be pɛ nɔ kendɛ wɔn
clean.tl: The son of God we know, we know no other like him.

clean.tx: lɔn lɔ pɛ che ma be wɔ kɛtkɛt
clean.tl: It is only there where people don't speak it regularly.

clean.tx: beo ŋa che mi bonth
clean.tl: No, they do not help me …

clean.tx: tem lan ma che na pɛ simi Planti ɛ
clean.tl: When the water comes, it would just slam and return, that time it would not have destroyed Plantain .

clean.tx: ŋɔ koŋ gbo we ha che mi paka
clean.tl: That is it, but they don't pay me.

clean.tx: a shini prɛs lan
clean.tl: They sell them , me I don't sell them, I don't know their price.

clean.tx: ŋa wɔɛ mɔ kɔ kɛnthi ɡbɔŋɡɔ landɛ be
clean.tl: Even a branch that you cut there, they would say you cut up the bush.

clean.tx: mɔ ma ha thoŋki
clean.tl: Are you teaching it to them?

clean.tx: n ma wɔ ka fe mi lɛ
clean.tl: Don't give him my money!

clean.tx: ha lɛ n ma wɔ pɔkɔni wɔ lɛ nɔdwiyɛ
clean.tl: You shouldn't forget about him, he's a thief!

clean.tx: n kɔ la hini
clean.tl: Go and arrange it!

clean.tx: mi pɛ mi ka yen tonton lɛ
clean.tl: Mummy, they give me a small something.

clean.tx: kɔŋgbɔl wɔ lɛ kɔ duk yɛ pɛ wɔ ku ilel ɛ
clean.tl: His heart beats when they call his name.

clean.tx: aŋa ɛ ŋa mɔ chɔŋ len
clean.tl: The people will love you.

clean.tx: chɛliɛ mi thɛn wɛi ya che kɔn pɔkɔni
clean.tl: He created a bad situation for me, I shall not forget it.

clean.tx: tɛm lan lɛ vɛ hɔ mɔi a
clean.tl: At that time how old were you?

clean.tx: mɔn apuma awɔ ŋa n bi a
clean.tl: ‎How many children do you have?

clean.tx: hina tongiɛ mɔ ŋa tɔn a
clean.tl: Who taught you how to sing?

clean.tx: bulɔ kendɛ handɔ
clean.tl: What kind of work?

clean.tx: ilel mɔa
clean.tl: What is your name?

clean.tx: ka che bomba nɛn thigber tha koŋ chaŋɛ
clean.tl: The Island of Egusi, this island was very big many years ago.

clean.tx: ŋan ɡbi pɛ yɛthiɛ ŋa
clean.tl: All of them, the people held them.

clean.tx: kil ɛ bɔɔko gaadin hɔ lɔ
clean.tl: There is a garden outside the house.

clean.tx: ya bi nrɔm ka ma mɔ bɔ ramir
clean.tl: ‎I have a medicine here, it can cure you.

clean.tx: thɔk bom lɛ kɔ lɔ vɛ ni che lɔ kɔ tɔn
clean.tl: The big tree that is there , she should go there and sing.

clean.tx: kɛ gbɔlkajo hɔ siŋ ka wɔ ayeŋ vɛ
clean.tl: Ba Spider formerly had a big waist equivalent to the other animals, but gluttony played with his middle.

clean.tx: ahina ŋa chaŋ si theli nbolom lɛ Shenge ka
clean.tl: Who speaks Sherbro best in Shenge?

clean.tx: wɔ chaŋ si theli nbolom lɛ
clean.tl: Ba Yanker knows how to speak Sherbro the best; he is the expert that knows how to speak Sherbro better .

clean.tx: n ke la bo la likɛlɛŋ a la bɔ yema
clean.tl: If you see it to be something indeed good, I can agree to it.

clean.tx: labila a wɔ ŋa biya kɔ lɔ gbɛ mɔi ke
clean.tl: That is why I said you need to go take a walk there, and you'll see …

clean.tx: n yema bi mi pinki lɛ wonɔ
clean.tl: You want to make me into a slave.

clean.tx: wɔŋ yi huŋ toŋgi ŋɔ pɛ chɛth keŋkeŋ ɛ
clean.tl: She is about to show us how to cook krain-krain.

clean.tx: bikɔs po mɔi biya hun jo ni theni yenkɛlɛŋ
clean.tl: Because your husband has to come eat and feel good.

clean.tx: a ke nɔ ɛ yɛ sɛmɛ kil ɛ koɛ
clean.tl: When I go I see the person standing in the room.

clean.tx: siŋ thiɛ tha vɛ tha yaŋ a ka che siŋɛ
clean.tl: Those are the games I used to play.

clean.tx: kɛ rai ɛ ŋalɛ hɔ lɔ lɔ a ka che makɛ
clean.tl: Every one of these papers has disappeared; it is just the other one that is there, where I used to keep records.

clean.tx: nɔmɔk lɛ kɔ hok wɔn minɛ lɛ kɔ isai
clean.tl: The mucus that comes from his nose is offensive.

clean.tx: hɔ nɔonɔ ka che ni kɔ ai ɛ
clean.tl: But there was a forest near the town, which no one entered.

clean.tx: Sese theyɛnnɛki thɔ lɛ kɛth wɔ yenwɛy
clean.tl: Sese hurt himself; the adze badly cut him.

clean.tx: la boɛ lɛkɛlɛkɛ ngbut
clean.tl: That's it, the story ends.

clean.tx: nɔ ɛ wɔ kil rithi ay ɛ wɔ mɔ toŋki ichɛli

clean.tx: nan baŋk baŋk nan tho
clean.tl: Pull a vine, and the vine pulls the bush.

clean.tx: su bul kɔ che ni leiŋ ila
clean.tl: One finger cannot remove a louse.

clean.tx: palli kɔni lɔ che sɛkɛli pɛlɛ
